title: Read authorized budget-category reference data with stable offline semantics

requirements.invariant: Later paid/unpaid budget progress groups exact contributions by stable project category without double counting. This reference slice preserves category identity/context only and cannot calculate, cache or alter accounting contributions.

Each Account budget category has stable identity, bounded display text, exactly one canonical general/itemized/fee kind, explicit active/archived and system state, explicit overall-budget exclusion and deterministic order/revision. Reference reads expose freshness rather than treating a cache as authority, and malformed or duplicate identity/name/order is explicit refusal.

requirements.section: Security and Sync Requirements for Later Target Mapping
requirements.invariant: The local snapshot contains only the principal-authorized visible subset. It neither performs authorization nor reveals hidden fee-category rows or counts; missing or ambiguous fee visibility fails closed at later server/download boundaries.

Stable category definitions and conflict-safe authorized reads are preserved, while Create/Update/Archive/Reorder category administration remains unavailable until O-026 defines the mutation authority and no Project allocation mutation is implied.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: One narrow backend-neutral budget-category reference query port exposes Account-scoped local snapshots using domain and standard Swift types only; it contains no generic CRUD, provider listener, authorization implementation or backend SDK type.

Reference data is an immutable local read model with stable query identity, LocalDataVersion, readiness/quality and as-of evidence; authorized empty, incomplete and stale local scope remain distinct and reconstruct only through the same validators.

This Phase 1 read boundary is executable only with deterministic provider-free evidence while the shipped app remains unchanged and no category table, RLS policy, Sync Stream, Auth/provider choice, source transform, hosted resource or production authority is introduced.

items: BudgetCategoryName is bounded, trimmed, nonblank product display text only; it cannot produce BudgetCategoryID, AccountID, visibility or authority.

BudgetCategoryKind has exactly general, itemized and fee. BudgetCategoryDefinitionSnapshot binds stable BudgetCategoryID, AccountID, display name, kind, active/archived lifecycle, system flag, overall-budget exclusion, unique presentation order and revision.

Project-configuration eligibility is derived only for active non-system visible rows; itemized workflow eligibility additionally requires kind itemized. Archived and system rows remain available for historical rendering but cannot enter those choices.

BudgetCategoryReferenceSnapshot wraps the shared validated ListLocalSnapshot contract, requires one AccountID, refuses duplicate category identity, normalized name and presentation order, and treats visibleRowCountBeforeFiltering as the already-authorized visible count only.
BudgetCategoryReferenceQuerying exposes only watchBudgetCategories(accountId:) local read streams; BudgetCategoryReferenceFailure provides stable safe name/account/duplicate/order/request codes.

postgresSchema.notApplicable: This Phase 1 provider-free contract creates no category table, enum, column, check, unique constraint, index, view or migration; the complete target vertical slice must define those after applicable gates.

serverHandlers.notApplicable: No Create/Update/Archive/Reorder category command, Project allocation command, transaction, lock, idempotency result or server read handler is implemented; O-026 remains open.

dataApiGrants.notApplicable: No relation, view or function is exposed through the Supabase Data API.

rlsPolicies.notApplicable: Account/value validation and visible-subset shape are not authorization. No server rows, membership/financial-visibility predicate, grants or RLS policies exist in this slice.

syncStreams.notApplicable: The read port consumes local snapshots but defines no PowerSync Stream, bucket parameter, local table, fee-visibility download rule or provider readiness proof.

items: Category values and snapshots are immutable Codable evidence and reconstruct only through the same name/type/account/identity/name/order validators.

The shared ListLocalSnapshot contract retains query fingerprint, bounded already-authorized rows/count, completeness, ready/partial/stale quality, LocalDataVersion and canonical as-of time across restart.
Cross-Account rows, duplicate category IDs/names/orders, invalid names/types/revisions and incomplete-authoritative claims fail atomically without returning a partial reference snapshot.

storageMedia.notApplicable: Budget-category reference values contain no image URL, AttachmentPath, byte reference, cache, upload, retention or deletion behavior.

appMcp.notApplicable: The shared read values and port semantics are defined, but no concrete Swift form/context, MCP TypeScript projection, transport handler, capability registration or entry point is wired in this foundation slice.

migrationReconciliation.notApplicable: No Firebase preset/category/order array is transformed and no metadata default or duplicate is repaired. Later migration must admit or quarantine every legacy category explicitly.

observabilityRunbooks.notApplicable: Stable local failure codes are contract values only; no telemetry emission, metric, alert or runbook action is added.

items: The implementation remains inside the existing provider-free LedgerTargetCore and test targets and is not linked by changing either application project.

This slice cannot activate reference-data features, authorize fee visibility, choose category administrators, mutate Project allocations, provision a database, import source data, deploy, release or cut over.

verification.expected: Valid synthetic visible rows preserve stable category identity, exact general/itemized/fee kind, lifecycle/system/exclusion/order/revision and exact active/non-system/itemized eligibility without an authorization or provider dependency.

Ready, partial, stale and authoritative-empty authorized snapshots round-trip byte-identically with stable presentation order, query fingerprint, LocalDataVersion and as-of evidence and no hidden-row/provider claim.

Invalid names/types/revisions, cross-Account rows, duplicate IDs/case-insensitive names/orders, malformed decoded rows and incomplete-as-authoritative snapshots fail atomically through stable budget-category reference codes.
A deterministic reference port returns only the exact Account snapshot, refuses a mismatched Account request without yielding rows and a failing port yields no false snapshot.

verification.owner: pull-request CI Isolated target environment job
verification.expected: The exact implementation commit passes conversion traceability, provider/source-contamination and generated-contract checks, the complete target suite, both target builds and clean artifacts without changing an application project or claiming server, authorization, provider, migration or production behavior.

notes: Decision-independent Phase 1 authorized-read contract only. O-026 remains fully open because no category definition or order mutation exists. Financial visibility is modeled as an already-authorized visible subset and is not decided locally. The slice stops before Project allocation configuration, physical durable storage, server/download authorization, schema/RLS/Sync/Auth/provider, app/MCP, source migration, hosted resources, production access or cutover.
